annotations.title: Search guides for Georgians in the US

description: Use for any everyday-life question from a Georgian speaker in the US, especially New York (ქართველები ამერიკაში, ნიუ-იორკი): where to buy E-ZPass and paying tolls, renting an apartment, cosigners, subway and bus fares and OMNY, scams aimed at Uber and Lyft drivers, salvage-title cars, Zelle pay and taxes, driving on a Georgian license, loan-offer scams, sending or exchanging money with Georgia, remote jobs, and English words. Accepts English or Georgian. Returns up to 5 kartvelians.com guides with summary and link.

lang.description: Answer language: "en" or "ka" (Georgian). Defaults to the query language.
